Name: Air Crystals
Description: These crystalline structures can be dissolved to provide breathable air, useful in situations of suffocation or underwater breathing.

Name: Alchemical Blood
Description: This synthetic blood can be used as a temporary replacement for lost blood, helping to stabilize bleeding creatures.

Name: Alchemical Grease
Description: A slippery substance that can be applied to surfaces or objects to make them difficult to grip or walk on.

Name: Alchemical Preserves
Description: These preservatives can extend the shelf life of perishable materials and prevent decomposition.

Name: Alchemist's Kindness
Description: A remedy that alleviates the effects of a hangover and helps recover from excessive alcohol consumption.

Name: Ambrosia (vial)
Description: This rare alchemical substance provides exceptional nourishment and can sustain a person for an extended period.

Name: Anderos Salve and Mulibrous Tincture
Description: A dual remedy used to treat gender-specific ailments and conditions.

Name: Anesthetic Wine
Description: Wine infused with pain-numbing agents, used before surgery or to dull severe pain.

Name: Antidote
Description: A specific remedy designed to counteract a particular poison. The cost and craft DC vary based on the poison being countered.

Name: Antiemetic Snuff
Description: A powder that, when inhaled, prevents nausea and vomiting.

Name: Antiplague
Description: A preventative measure against disease, granting a bonus to saves against contracting illnesses.

Name: Antitoxin
Description: A universal remedy that provides resistance to poisons for a limited time.

Name: Antivenom
Description: A specialized antitoxin designed to counteract venom from specific creatures. Cost and DC vary by creature type.

Name: Applecheek
Description: A cosmetic substance that gives the wearer a healthy, rosy complexion.

Name: Aquemir
Description: A rare alchemical substance with potent curative properties.

Name: Bladeguard
Description: A protective coating applied to weapons and armor to prevent rust and corrosion.

Name: Blain Bane
Description: An ointment that treats boils, blisters, and other skin inflammations.

Name: Blood-Boiling Pill
Description: When ingested, this pill raises the user's body temperature, providing resistance to cold.

Name: Blood-Chilling Pill
Description: When ingested, this pill lowers the user's body temperature, providing resistance to heat.

Name: Blood-Clotter Salve
Description: Applied to wounds, this salve promotes rapid blood clotting and reduces bleeding.

Name: Bloodgorge
Description: A stimulant that increases blood flow and enhances physical performance temporarily.

Name: Boulderhead Bock
Description: A thick, fortifying drink favored by dwarves that bolsters constitution.

Name: Calistria's Kindness
Description: An alchemical contraceptive that prevents pregnancy when consumed.

Name: Chameleon Ointment
Description: When applied to skin, this ointment helps the user blend with their surroundings.

Name: Curative Myrrh
Description: A healing resin that accelerates natural recovery when applied to wounds.

Name: Distilled Terrap Sap
Description: A sticky sap with adhesive and medicinal properties.

Name: Essence of Independence
Description: This essence grants temporary resistance to mind-affecting effects and compulsions.

Name: Eye Drops of the Unseen Master
Description: These drops enhance vision and provide bonuses to visual Perception checks.

Name: Fire Ward Gel
Description: A gel that, when applied to skin or clothing, provides temporary protection against fire damage.

Name: Fortifying Brew
Description: A nutritious drink that bolsters stamina and endurance.

Name: Fortifying Fertilizer
Description: An alchemical fertilizer that dramatically accelerates plant growth and improves crop yields.

Name: Frost Ward Gel
Description: A gel that, when applied to skin or clothing, provides temporary protection against cold damage.

Name: Frostbite Ointment
Description: An ointment that treats frostbite and prevents further cold damage to affected areas.

Name: Fury Drops
Description: Eye drops that enhance combat focus and aggression, providing bonuses in battle.

Name: Gildea Myrrh
Description: A special variety of myrrh with enhanced healing properties.

Name: Icecap Ale
Description: A chilled ale that provides temporary resistance to cold environments.

Name: Iniquitous Panacea
Description: A powerful but morally questionable cure-all with potent healing properties.

Name: Insight Leaves
Description: When chewed, these leaves enhance mental clarity and provide bonuses to Wisdom-based checks.

Name: Lantern Honey
Description: A luminescent honey that provides light when consumed or applied.

Name: Liquid Breeze
Description: When opened, this vial releases a pleasant cooling breeze.

Name: Longbeard Lambic
Description: A dwarven ale known for promoting healthy beard growth.

Name: Loping Ointment
Description: Applied to legs and feet, this ointment temporarily increases movement speed.

Name: Loyalty Transfusion
Description: A rare substance that strengthens bonds of loyalty and resists compulsions to betray.

Name: Meditation Tea
Description: This calming tea aids in meditation and helps regain mental focus.

Name: Mellowroot (vial)
Description: A mild sedative that calms nerves and reduces anxiety.

Name: Memory Incense
Description: When burned, this incense enhances memory recall and concentration.

Name: Muscle Grout
Description: A paste applied to sore muscles to reduce pain and accelerate recovery from strain.

Name: Nostalgia Oil
Description: An aromatic oil that evokes pleasant memories and improves morale.

Name: Padzahr
Description: A powerful antitoxin from Qadiran tradition that neutralizes many poisons.

Name: Phantom Ash
Description: Ash that creates ghostly after-images when scattered, useful for deception.

Name: Poison Ward Salve
Description: Applied to skin, this salve provides a small degree of protection against contact poisons.

Name: Purification Pellet
Description: Dissolves in water to purify it, making contaminated water safe to drink.

Name: Rager's Aid
Description: A substance that enhances rage and berserker abilities when consumed.

Name: Salt Tablets (10)
Description: Tablets that help prevent dehydration and maintain electrolyte balance in hot environments.

Name: Scarsalve
Description: A cosmetic ointment that reduces the appearance of scars over time.

Name: Semblance Transfusion
Description: A rare alchemical substance that temporarily alters one's appearance.

Name: Smelling Salts
Description: Pungent salts that can revive unconscious creatures and negate certain conditions.

Name: Soothe Syrup
Description: A sweet syrup that soothes sore throats and calms coughs.

Name: Soul Stimulant
Description: A powerful remedy that can restore drained life force and negative levels.

Name: Stillgut (vial)
Description: A substance that settles the stomach and prevents digestive distress.

Name: Stink Ink (arcane)
Description: Magical ink that releases a foul odor when specific conditions are met.

Name: Stink Ink (common)
Description: Non-magical ink that releases an unpleasant smell to mark or deter thieves.

Name: Sun Cream
Description: A protective cream that prevents sunburn and reduces sun damage.

Name: Surge Syrup
Description: A powerful stimulant that provides a temporary burst of energy and speed.

Name: Surgical Jelly
Description: A sterile gel used during surgery to prevent infection and promote healing.

Name: Sweet Rest
Description: A pleasant-tasting sedative that induces deep, restful sleep.

Name: Synthetic Mumia
Description: An alchemical substitute for mummy wrappings, with similar preservative properties.

Name: Tea of Transference
Description: A tea that allows limited sharing of sensory experiences between drinkers.

Name: Troll Oil
Description: An oil that mimics troll regeneration, promoting rapid healing when applied.

Name: Troll Styptic
Description: A powerful coagulant made from troll blood that stops bleeding almost instantly.

Name: Twitch Tonic
Description: A tonic that enhances reflexes and provides bonuses to initiative and Reflex saves.

Name: Vapors of Easy Breath
Description: When released, these vapors make breathing easier in thin air or polluted environments.

Name: Venombane Lozenges
Description: Lozenges that provide minor protection against inhaled poisons and toxins.

Name: Vermin Repellent
Description: A substance applied to skin or clothing that repels insects and other small vermin.

Name: Vivifying Moxibustion Needles
Description: Acupuncture needles that, when properly applied, restore vitality and cure fatigue.

Name: War Spirit Pouch
Description: A pouch containing herbs and charms that bolster courage and combat prowess.

Name: Wing Oil
Description: An oil that, when applied to wings, improves flight performance.

Name: Wismuth Salix
Description: A remedy that soothes digestive ailments and stomach upset.

Name: Wyrm's Breath Bitter
Description: A bitter drink that provides temporary resistance to dragon breath weapons.
